content: Go YAML 2026 state: gopkg.in/yaml.v3 frozen at v3.0.1 (2022, maintenance mode, zero external deps, ecosystem default, stable for config files, DoS issues fixed in v3.0.1). github.com/goccy/go-yaml v1.19.2 (2026-01-08, actively developed, also zero external deps per go.mod, better error messages with line/col, comment round-trip). For goswitch minimal-dep constraint either is fine; yaml.v3 is the conservative default, goccy if strict typing/comment round-trip wanted. YAML spec is v1.2-only in both; note 'on/off/yes/no' are strings not bools.
